item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 reporting showing Modi filling top economic posts with family members or business partners. I also did not find strong direct evidence about the degree of day-to-day empowerment these professionals had inside the PMO; the reporting is strongest on appointment continuity and institutional staffing, weaker on autonomy.","evidence":[{"title":"India’s Modi prevails over allies in cabinet line-up","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"11 Jun 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/india/indias-modi-prevails-over-allies-in-cabinet-line-up/2126130/","summary":"Modi kept the finance ministry and other senior economic portfolios in the same hands after the election setback, which is the clearest evidence of continuity in economic staffing rather than a turnover to obvious loyalists.","question_ids":["5B.2","4B.10"]},{"title":"Indian government appoints members for new finance panel","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"30 Jan 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/indian-government-appoints-members-for-new-finance-panel-3287402","summary":"The government named a technocratic Finance Commission team including former expenditure officials, a policy executive, SBI’s chief economic adviser, and economist Arvind Panagariya as chair, which supports the view that Modi relied on experienced economic professionals in major fiscal institutions.","question_ids":["5B.2"]},{"title":"India’s budget keeps spending in check; sees modest increase in revenue","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"1 Feb 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/india/indias-budget-keeps-spending-in-check-sees-modest-increase-in-revenue/1949061/","summary":"The interim budget stayed fiscally tight despite the election year, raised capital expenditure, and avoided a classic pre-poll giveaway, which is positive evidence that the economic team was allowed to pursue longer-term fiscal management.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]},{"title":"Shri Sanjay Malhotra takes over as RBI Governor","publisher":"Reserve Bank of India","date":"11 Dec 2024","url":"https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=59281","summary":"Modi’s government appointed Sanjay Malhotra, a career IAS officer with finance, taxation, IT, and revenue experience, as RBI governor; that is strong technocratic evidence, though it is still a bureaucratic rather than independent-economist appointment.","question_ids":["5B.2"]},{"title":"India’s Modi spends billions on jobs, key allies in first budget after election","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"23 Jul 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/india/indias-modi-spends-billions-on-jobs-key-allies-in-first-budget-after-election/2187546/","summary":"The first post-election budget directed large sums to jobs, rural programs, and coalition-partner states explicitly to win back voters and retain political support, which is counterevidence that economic policy was insulated from short-term political bargaining.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]},{"title":"India’s Modi faces delicate balancing act in post-election budget","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"23 Jul 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/india/indias-modi-faces-delicate-balancing-act-in-post-election-budget/2186495/","summary":"Reuters described the budget as balancing fiscal prudence with disgruntled voters and coalition demands, showing that economic decisionmaking was constrained by political management rather than purely professional autonomy.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]}]}
